product_metadata.title: HC COLLECTION King Duvet Cover Set - 1500 Thread Lightweight Duvet Covers with Zipper Closure for Comforters w/ 2 Pillow Shams - Camel
features: Full set to enhance your Bedroom: Wrap yourself in a cozy modern bedding. The King size bed set measures 104"x90" and comes with 2 added sham pillow cases so you can complete a clean and beautiful look.

Durable Construction: The microfiber in our covers is made with double-brushed microfiber, creating a soft fabric that won't fade in the wash. Colors might look differently than in the picture under different lighting conditions.

Protection for your Comforter: Thanks to our secure zipper closure, this cover act as a giant pillow case for your comforter, keeping it clean and protected. With this Queen duvet cover, you'll be sleeping in satisfaction for years to come.
Year-round Comfort: From hot summer nights to cool winter days, our Queen size duvet cover set will keep your temperature regulated, so you can catch some much-needed Z's.

Machine Washable: No need to lose sleep over suds and carry around those heavy comforters. Toss your pillow covers along with your cooling duvet cover sets into the washing machine for a super easy clean!
